text:
alex: Heads-up — EU fleet bump: vendor just confirmed a +40 H100 allocation landing next week but flagged ~6 units as DOA returns. Need RMA consolidation plan, HS code for customs, and whether we can avoid split AWBs. @vendor-logistics can you confirm options?

vendor-logistics: We can consolidate up to 30 units on one AWB to the NL depot (AMS). If vendor insists on split AWBs for DOA handling we can still remerge at crossdock but that adds ~24-48h. Carrier needs HS code and declared value per unit to quote insurance.

natalie: If they split AWBs can we nominate a single customs broker to avoid duplicate brokerage fees? AMS depot preferred.

ops-bot: Shipment kickoff: provisional AWB LX123456789 created (split AWBs pending vendor manifest). ETA AMS warehouse 2024-05-14 08:00Z. I'll update when consolidated AWB is issued.

ivan: Cost delta for consolidation vs split: consolidation brokerage estimate +€1,200 (single broker + rework), split AWBs ~€800 total but higher handling risk. Also we need temporary loaners to keep clusters healthy while RMAs route.

kevin: I prefer consolidate to reduce customs touchpoints if we can accept the marginal premium. Do we have loaners in region? @maya

maya: We have 8 H100 loaners in EU pool, can allocate 6. Blocking them now. Need vendor to provide full serial manifest + RMA docs so we can tag loaners to affected clusters and avoid double-alloc.

vendor-logistics: Sending consolidated manifest in ~30m. Vendor currently uses HS code 8471.80 for server GPUs; can confirm 8471.70 if customs insists. Carrier requires depositor EORI (provide asap) and photos for DOA cases for depot inspection.

alex: Change-of-plan: route consolidated shipment to AMS (not FRA) to minimize customs holdups. Mark as PRIORITY to push through customs clearance faster.

natalie: Also note procurement cost center 3227 for this operation. Please update the ticket and include the insurance breakdown.

vendor-logistics: Manifest uploaded: https://files.vendor/manifest/344321-manifest.pdf — AWBs LX123456789 / LY987654321. We can issue a single consolidated AWB if we receive written approval by EOD and confirm EORI + declared values.

ivan: Approve consolidation. Question on insurance: can carrier reduce declared value to cap premium? Procurement prefers capping at 70% to cut premium but that increases our risk.

vendor-logistics: Carrier policy: declared value is required; reducing below market value may void some claims. We can subsidize 50% of the premium on consolidated AWB. Quote: €1,800 total premium, vendor covers €900, you cover €900. If split AWBs, premium rises to ~€2,300.

kevin: Sounds fair. I'll allocate €900 to 3227. @maya once vendor confirms pick-up you can unreserve loaners and post serials for handover.

maya: Done — 6 loaners reserved (ids: EU-LN-101..EU-LN-106). I'll post serials to the ticket when I release them.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll place a temporary canary hold on deployments touching the affected node pools until depot inspection completes and RMAs clear.

maya: Prewarm plan for loaners to avoid cold KV cache: 
```bash
# quick prewarm
for host in $(cat loaner_hosts.txt); do
  ssh admin@$host "curl -sS http://metadata.local/warm?model=h100 &> /dev/null"
done
```

ops-bot: Note added to infra-runbook: 'RMA consolidation — AMS preferred, consolidate if <=30, vendor premium cost-share 50%'.

vendor-logistics: We'll send final consolidated AWB and signed insurance waiver by EOD once you confirm EORI and approval.

alex: Confirming approval. EORI for Redwood EU: EU123456789. Proceed with consolidation and vendor-subsidized premium. Keep channel posted.

ops-bot: Closing loop: will post final AWB and depot intake when available. :thumbsup:
